title: Sponsor-funded sham employment with value return
disclaimer: Simulated risk pattern for human review. It is a hypothesis generated from synthetic agent behaviour and untrusted annex text; it is not evidence that any real person or organisation did anything.

actors.title: Employer Agent
goals: Reduce net training and hiring cost

actors.title: Trainee Agent
goals: Maximise personal benefit from subsidised training credits

classification_basis: 3 actors are each necessary and value/information flows between actors

simulated_behaviour.capability_label: Employment created mainly to access training funding
simulated_behaviour.summary: Employer hires individuals mainly so they can attend a funded course.
simulated_behaviour.label: SIMULATED - not a finding of fact

simulated_behaviour.capability_label: Employment ends soon after course completion
simulated_behaviour.summary: Employment ends soon after the course finishes.
simulated_behaviour.label: SIMULATED - not a finding of fact

simulated_behaviour.capability_label: Sponsor pays the nett course fee
simulated_behaviour.summary: Employer acts as sponsor and pays the nett fee.
simulated_behaviour.label: SIMULATED - not a finding of fact

simulated_behaviour.capability_label: Hire who attends a course with no other work
simulated_behaviour.summary: A hired trainee attends the course as the main duty.
simulated_behaviour.label: SIMULATED - not a finding of fact

simulated_behaviour.capability_label: Value flows back to the sponsor via the provider
simulated_behaviour.summary: Value returns to the sponsor via the provider after the fee is received.
simulated_behaviour.label: SIMULATED - not a finding of fact

source_material.text: Employment created for grants: People are hired only to attend a course and are let go afterwards
Indirect kickback through a sponsor: A sponsor pays the nett fee while value flows back through the provider

assumptions.text: Annex A lists MO-08 as a policy risk, not an observed case; the return path is hypothesised.

data_needed_for_testing.dataset: Payroll and work-activity records for course attendees
Employment/CPF-style contribution history vs. course dates
data_needed_for_testing.test: Tenure that starts shortly before and ends shortly after a funded course

data_needed_for_testing.dataset: Payer vs. participant relationships on fee records
data_needed_for_testing.test: Sponsors paying for large numbers of unrelated participants

data_needed_for_testing.dataset: Provider payment and refund flows with sponsor-linked parties
data_needed_for_testing.test: Payments from provider to sponsor-linked parties near fee receipt

data_needed_for_testing.dataset: Prior cases of the closest known MO
data_needed_for_testing.test: Check whether the variant elements appear in historical cases

concerns: MO-08 is a policy risk, not an observed case.

approval.notes: MO-08 is a policy risk; reviewer opinion (strong) disagrees with computed support (moderate). Re-run with more evidence.
